verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm with an IP/IT/Data Protection practice, so documenting trade-secret work is a fair question for it. However, no evidence covers trade-secret protection, confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes or trade-secret litigation. The IP page describes building up and realizing IP assets in VC/PE transactions, and the fintech page mentions IP issues around NFTs. Both are adjacent IP work, not trade-secret work.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation
